reason: Lint: the five react/refs warnings in RouteBends and FrameLayer are fixed. The latest bend close and frame key-gesture end are set in a layout effect after each commit instead of during render, and each key gesture is made on its first use in a handler or an effect instead of in a render-time useMemo. The frame title chip no longer keeps its size reporter in a ref: it is given the frame id and the frame layer's stable reporter, so its callback ref, which runs in the commit before the chip's own effects, calls the reporter it was made with. A ref assigned in a layout effect was measured and not taken for the chip: in the browser it called the previous render's reporter once on each popover open or close and each lock or unlock. A new node-structure-small test pins the chip moved off a name keeping its place through the popover and a lock; it cannot tell those two forms apart, since both report for the same frame. npm run lint fails above 61 warnings (was 66). #625 item 5.
